result.reason: The clause includes the preferred CGL, E&O, and conditional cyber/privacy limits and provides for certificates on request, but it omits workers’ compensation insurance as required by law. It also adds an unsupported one-year post-termination maintenance period, so it changes more than necessary. Unrelated provisions remain intact, but placing Section 14.9A after Section 14.10 is awkward and should be renumbered.
